reasoning: As of March 2026, I need to assess the likelihood of a 25 bps rate cut at the June 2026 FOMC meeting. The Fed has been in a rate-cutting cycle since late 2024, but the pace depends on inflation and employment data. By June 2026, the Fed may be nearing the end of its easing cycle or pausing. Market expectations typically show multiple possible outcomes (no change, 25 bps cut, 50 bps cut). A 25 bps cut is a common incremental move, but the Fed might also hold steady if inflation remains sticky or cut more aggressively if the economy weakens. I estimate moderate probability for exactly 25 bps.
